import os
import sys
import time
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from tqdm import tqdm

# Silence tqdm progress bars
tqdm.tqdm._write = lambda *args: None


def main():
    # Set working directories based on provided structure
    input_dir = "input"
    submission_dir = "submission"

    # Ensure output directory exists
    os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # Load training data
    train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/train.csv")

    # Load test data
    test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/test.csv")

    # Load sample submission for reference format
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv")

    print("Starting preprocessing...")

    # Extract labels for training (EAP, HPL, MWS)
    label_cols = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

    # One-hot encode labels
    train_labels = train_df["author"].map(
        {"EAP": [1, 0, 0], "HPL": [0, 1, 0], "MWS": [0, 0, 1]}
    )

    print("Training TF-IDF vectorizer...")

    # TF-IDF Vectorization
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
    )

    X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text"].values)
    y_train = train_labels

    print("Training classifier...")

    # Train model
    clf = LogisticRegression(random_state=42, solver="lbfgs", C=1.0, max_iter=1000)
    clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

    print("Creating hold-out validation split (80/20)...")

    # Hold-out validation set
    indices = np.random.permutation(len(X_train))[: int(len(X_train) * 0.8)]
    val_indices = indices[int(len(X_train) * 0.8) :]

    X_val = X_train[indices]
    y_val = y_train.loc[train_df.iloc[indices]["author"]]

    print("Evaluating on hold-out validation set...")

    # Predict on validation set
    y_pred_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_val)

    # Calculate log loss using only valid classes (3 classes)
    # Convert labels back to integer indices
    label_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
    y_val_idx = y_val.map(label_map).values

    # Validate metric
    validation_log_loss = log_loss(
        y_val_idx, y_pred_proba, weights=None, labels=[0, 1, 2]
    )

    print(f"Validation Log Loss: {validation_log_loss:.6f}")

    print("Generating predictions on test set...")

    X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"].values)
    test_predictions = clf.predict_proba(X_test)

    # Create submission dataframe
    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "id": test_df["id"],
            "EAP": test_predictions[:, 0],
            "HPL": test_predictions[:, 1],
            "MWS": test_predictions[:, 2],
        }
    )

    # Ensure proper rounding
    submission[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]] = submission[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]].round(6)

    # Save submission file
    submission.to_csv(f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

    return validation_log_loss


if __name__ == "__main__":
    score = main()
    print(f"\nFinal Validation Score: {score:.6f}")
